evidence_gaps: Fresh runtime evidence within two hours, including configuration and source-version attestation.
Per-chain, per-strategy closed-trade ledger with capital-weighted realised NET P&L after entry and exit fees, slippage, price impact, priority fees/gas, rent/account costs and profit-share charges.
Exact pretrade quotes, quote age, intended size, expected output, minimum output, actual fill/output and quote-to-fill deterioration.
Complete failed-attempt ledger covering rejected signals, RPC/HTTP faults, simulations, reverts, paid failed transactions, missing outputs, reconciliation failures and exit failures.
Separate STRATEGY/MARKET and EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE attribution with deduplication and reconciliation to wallet balances and transactions.
Solana mint-level sellability, liquidity depth, congestion/priority-fee regime and unresolved-position evidence.
EVM chain-specific gas distributions, revert costs, liquidity depth, taxes/transfer behaviour, router paths and follower-size impact.
Out-of-sample and regime-separated expectancy, profit factor, maximum drawdown, tail loss and confidence intervals for each strategy and chain.

Before any promotion: positive failure-inclusive money-weighted NET P&L with a predefined safety margin, adequate independent sample size, no unresolved accounting or sellability failures, stable out-of-sample results, and verified operation of all risk and execution safeguards.

proposals.downside_risk: More conservative scoring may delay discovery of genuinely improving strategies and requires adequate loss and failure capture.

evidence.detail: avg_net is calculated only from positive PROVEN_WRAPPED_BASE observations, excluding proven losses.
Confidence and replicability increase with proof and positive counts but contain no money-weighted loss, profit-factor, drawdown, execution-failure or out-of-sample penalty.

proposals.expected_effect: Fewer false-positive strategy candidates and selection aligned with durable money-weighted NET P&L.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 closed cost-complete observations per route family, including losses, across at least three wallets and two non-overlapping time windows; otherwise retain DORMANT/RESEARCH status.
proposals.rationale: Positive-only averaging biases selection toward raw successes and can label a route attractive even when a few larger losses make aggregate NET P&L negative.
proposals.shadow_test: In SHADOW, compare current scoring with a candidate score using every proven net result, gross-profit/gross-loss, worst loss, capital-weighted return and execution-failure cost. Reject the candidate model if its held-out aggregate net after all costs is not positive, if profit factor is not above 1.0 with a predefined safety margin, or if tail loss worsens materially.

proposals.downside_risk: An alpha estimate may be unstable and over-filter trades; stale leader-return estimates could create false confidence.

evidence.detail: _validate_entry checks signal age, product policy, entry deterioration, sellability and a maximum round-trip-loss percentage.
An entry passes whenever round-trip loss is below a configured ceiling; no explicit expected-alpha-minus-entry-gas-minus-exit-gas-minus-impact margin is required.
Estimated buy gas is added to recorded entry cost after admission, so an economically negative follower trade can pass preflight.
Leader qualification requires positive historical gas-adjusted net, but does not establish that the delayed, smaller follower has positive executable edge under current chain conditions.

proposals.expected_effect: Suppress EVM SHADOW entries where copied alpha cannot cover two-sided gas, current price impact, slippage and a conservative uncertainty buffer.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 independently closed SHADOW signals per EVM chain and at least 14 days spanning multiple gas regimes, with exact quote timestamps, gas estimates, realised quotes and failure outcomes.
proposals.rationale: EVM gas and AMM impact vary materially by chain and trade size. A fixed loss ceiling is a safety filter, not proof of positive follower edge.
proposals.shadow_test: Record, without trading, leader expected remaining return and contemporaneous buy/sell quotes for the exact follower size. Admit only when conservative expected proceeds minus entry principal, entry gas, exit gas, quoted impact, slippage allowance and failure-cost reserve is positive. Fail the hypothesis if admitted signals do not produce positive aggregate cost-complete net, if any chain is subsidised by another chain, or if rejected signals materially outperform admitted signals after identical costs.

proposals.downside_risk: Taxonomy errors or duplicate events can distort attribution; records must be deduplicated by signal and transaction identity.

evidence.detail: Solana distinguishes landed invalid output from generic failed-no-retry attempts and has an execution-fault circuit breaker.
EVM BUY exceptions are silently continued without a durable strategy-versus-execution classification in this path.
Position-monitor quote failures are continued, which prevents the architecture alone from determining failure duration or economic exposure.

proposals.expected_effect: Reliable net expectancy by chain and strategy, including opportunity loss and paid fees from failed execution, without conflating market selection with infrastructure reliability.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 signals per chain with complete stage timestamps, quote snapshots, attempted transaction identity, fee outcome and terminal classification; all paid failures must reconcile.
proposals.rationale: Strategy selection becomes biased if reverted, timed-out, unreconciled or unexitable attempts disappear, or if infrastructure failures are counted as market losses. Conversely, a successfully executed adverse move is a STRATEGY/MARKET loss even when infrastructure operated correctly.
proposals.shadow_test: Build a report-only SHADOW ledger classifying every signal as rejected-no-edge, strategy/market loss after successful execution model, pre-broadcast infrastructure failure, on-chain execution failure with paid cost, post-execution reconciliation failure, or exit/liquidity failure. Stop promotion if any material uncategorised bucket remains, totals do not reconcile, or failure-inclusive net differs from position-only net enough to reverse the decision.

proposals.downside_risk: Fixed fee estimates, quote-to-fill drift and delayed exits may still overstate SHADOW results; conservative gates may also reduce sample acquisition.

evidence.detail: SHADOW entry and valuation use executable Jupiter order quotes, including immediate reverse-quote sellability.
LIVE architecture requires simulation, single-signer validation, successful execute output and swap events.
Leader admission uses historical and recent median returns plus realised amount and mint-loss controls.
Copied performance uses money-weighted gross profit, gross loss, net and profit factor rather than win count alone.

proposals.expected_effect: Preserves fail-closed sellability, execution validation and realised-loss quarantine while runtime evidence is gathered.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 cost-complete closed SHADOW positions over at least 14 days, at least five distinct mints and multiple congestion periods, with no unresolved sellability or accounting gaps.
proposals.rationale: These controls are directionally aligned with executable NET P&L and should not be weakened. Architecture quality does not demonstrate actual profitability.
proposals.shadow_test: Compare every SHADOW entry and exit quote with contemporaneous executable order data and, where available without trading, simulation results. Include priority fees, rent/account creation, slippage, quote expiry and failed-exit exposure. Fail if cost-complete aggregate net is non-positive, quote-to-result deterioration consumes the safety margin, or liquidity failures create unreconciled positions.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote either chain to CANARY or LIVE from repository architecture.
rejected_ideas.reason: Fresh runtime forensics are unavailable; architecture cannot establish profitability, execution reliability or current market edge.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or force entries to improve win count.
rejected_ideas.reason: Frequency without positive executable edge compounds fees and adverse selection; raw win count is not the objective.

rejected_ideas.idea: Use one universal edge threshold across Solana and EVM.
rejected_ideas.reason: Solana priority fees, rent/account effects and Jupiter routing differ from EVM gas, router impact and revert economics.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat all losing or missed trades as strategy losses.
rejected_ideas.reason: Successfully executed adverse outcomes are STRATEGY/MARKET losses, while quote, RPC, simulation, revert, missing-output, reconciliation and exit-submission faults are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. Solana has comparatively strong executable-quote, sellability, fee-aware P&L, realised-amount profit-factor and execution-validation controls. EVM leader history includes gas, but entry admission only caps deterioration and round-trip loss; it does not require the follower's expected return to exceed entry gas, exit gas, price impact, slippage and a safety margin. Strategy-pattern learning also computes average net from positive observations only, which can promote patterns with poor money-weighted outcomes. No profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness conclusion is permitted because current runtime forensics are absent. STRATEGY/MARKET losses must be measured from successfully executed positions with adverse net outcomes; quote, RPC, simulation, revert, missing-output, reconciliation and exit-submission faults must be reported separately as EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
